about: Kinds of network question a coding session asks: does a name resolve, does a host and port answer, what does a URL return, when does a certificate expire and who issued it, why can something not be reached. The model questions (`q`) use only things that stay true: example.com and github.com (public, checked on 2026-11-21), localhost port 1 (nothing listens there), and two certificate files in bench/fixture (made for this bench: a certificate for watch.example.com signed by a private CA, and an expired self-signed one; both asked about at the fixed date 2026-06-01 so the calendar does not change the answer). The shots (`do`) run with no model: selftest starts a throwaway server on loopback inside the run and stops it. Questions that need the internet fail on a machine with none. The expectations were checked against the kit's output on 2026-11-21. The model questions have not been run on a model.

questions.q: Does example.com resolve from this machine, and does anything answer on port 443 there?
What does https://example.com return: the status, and what is the page title?
Where does http://github.com redirect to, and with which status?
In bench/fixture/expired.pem, is the certificate valid at 2026-06-01? Who issued it and when did it expire?
In bench/fixture/watch.pem, which names does the certificate cover, who issued it, and when does it expire?

expect: root is not in this machine's trust store
